artifacts.description: Quartus Prime Pro EDA netlist export (version not recorded in the header)

assumptions.description: Coverage means the primitive semantics in tools/hal_agilex/primitives.py, which were validated by simulating this export against the RTL it was synthesised from.
The .vo reader refuses Verilog it does not understand, so an instance cannot have been skipped silently.

bounds.description: a statement about the netlist text, not about an execution

method.description: Enumeration of every instance in the export and of the pin configuration of each one; no solver and no simulation involved.
method.name: primitive inventory

findings.summary: All 120 instances are tennm_ff or tennm_lcell_comb, each in a configuration this package models and has validated against the vendor export.
findings.title: Every primitive in the export is inside the validated coverage
